candidates.snippet: 1850: Graduated from Main Pedagogical Institute - Mendeleev graduated from the Main Pedagogical Institute in Saint Petersburg, marking the beginning of his scientific career. 1869: Published 'Principles of Chemistry' - Mendeleev published his seminal work 'Principles of Chemistry,' which laid out his periodic system of elements. 1892: Appointed Director of the Bureau of Weights and Measures - Mendeleev was appointed Director of the Bureau of Weights and Measures, a significant role in standardizing measurements. 1905: Awarded the Copley Medal - Mendeleev received the prestigious Copley Medal from the Royal Society for his contributions to chemistry.
